name: S10-G1 D1 FT256 vs FT128-v3 same-binary

experiment.purpose: G1 capacity probe: 1M material-residual FT256 (seed 20260819, val 137.811 / holdout 137.048) vs the payload-identical FT128 v3 twin (E3 seed 20260820). Same binary/profile/data/teacher/quant scheme/artifact version; ONLY the FT width differs. Tests whether +1.12cp offline accuracy covers the measured -18.9% paired NPS cost.
